$comment: How many MAJOR versions ahead of npm the published Rust crates run. This five-key object is release metadata: preserve `$comment`; for each new Rust-only major increment `majorOffset` by exactly one, append the previous `latestBreak` to `reason` with exactly one separating space, replace `latestBreak` with the new non-empty break account, and append its issue/PR entries to `refs` without removing or reordering existing refs. scripts/sync-versions.js applies the offset; scripts/check-rust-major-offset.mjs validates it. See docs/contributing/release.md.
reason: Rust-only break #2: carrying the representation-item id on GPU-instanced occurrences (#2985) adds a public field to four structs that are exhaustively constructible through the public API, so any downstream struct literal stops compiling. Measured with cargo-semver-checks against the published 7.1.1, --release-type minor: ifc-lite-geometry 196 checks, 195 pass, 1 fail, 58 skip (InstanceMeshRef::item_id, DecodedInstance::item_id); ifc-lite-processing the same verdict (InstanceRecord::geometry_item_id, RawInstanceOccurrence::geometry_item_id). Both report "semver requires new major version: 1 major and 0 minor checks failed" on constructible_struct_adds_field. None of the four is #[non_exhaustive], and adding that attribute would itself be breaking, so the feature cannot ship without a major. The npm packages carry only a minor, and a changeset written about the TypeScript API cannot express a Rust break. The previous offset of 1 is retained in history: this raises it rather than replacing it, because the offset is cumulative against the npm major. Rust-only break #2 also covers `ifc-lite-export`, which acquired four constructible-struct fields in the same unpublished cycle: `StepStats.refused_refs`, `MergedOptions.drop_empty_containers`, `MergedStats.dropped_container_count` and `GltfStats.unverified_instance_groups` (#3666). Re-measured with cargo-semver-checks 0.50.0 against the published 7.1.1, --release-type minor: 196 checks, 195 pass, 1 fail, 58 skip, the one failure being constructible_struct_adds_field naming all four, and "semver requires new major version". None of the four structs is #[non_exhaustive] and the repo's precedent for RESULT/stats structs is a plain struct (only the OPTIONS structs `GltfOptions` and `ModelOptions` carry the attribute), so adding it would itself be a break rather than the way this is recorded. The offset is NOT raised again: it went to 2 on 2026-08-30, after the last publish tag, so the 8.x major it implies is still pending and these fields ride it. This entry is the record of what else that major covers. Rust-only break #3: BoolFailureReason gains variants on an enum that is re-exported from the crate root and is NOT #[non_exhaustive], so any downstream exhaustive match stops compiling. Measured with cargo-semver-checks against the published crate, --release-type minor, on ifc-lite-geometry: "semver requires new major version: 3 major and 0 minor checks failed". The three are enum_variant_added on BoolFailureReason::OpenTopologyRejected (added by #3717) and on BoolFailureReason::NonManifoldRejected (added by #3440 step 3), plus function_parameter_count_changed on aggregate_diagnostics, which went from 5 to 6 parameters in #3766. Only the second is new here: the other two are already on main and were never recorded, so the release lane was blocked before this change and one offset bump covers all three - they are all in the same unpublished window, which is why cargo-semver-checks still sees them against the registry. Adding #[non_exhaustive] to BoolFailureReason would itself be breaking, so the variants cannot ship without a major. The npm packages carry only a patch, and a changeset written about the TypeScript API cannot express a Rust break. Raises the previous offset of 2 rather than replacing it: the offset is cumulative against the npm major. Rust-only break #4: TWO constructible-struct field additions landed after the 9.4.0 publish (npm 6.4.0 + offset 3), so unlike breaks #2 and #3 they do NOT ride a pending major: the major implied by offset 3 is published. Measured with cargo-semver-checks 0.50.0 against the published 9.4.0, on main at 92e590337: ifc-lite-geometry fails constructible_struct_adds_field on Mesh.welded_in_object_frame (rust/geometry/src/mesh.rs:70, added by #4182 for #4122's welded-in-object-frame bit), and ifc-lite-export fails the same lint on StepStats.attribute_edits_refused (rust/export/src/step_api.rs:130, added by #4213 for #4125's by-index split validation). Both report "semver requires new major version: 1 major and 0 minor checks failed". Raising the offset rather than reverting both fields: each is load-bearing telemetry for the fix that added it, and #4193 has already shown what reverting costs (OpeningDiagnostic lost triangle_count purely to keep 9.4.1 a patch, and the classifier's own diagnostic can no longer explain its kind). Rust-only break #5: the appearance slices merged after the 11.0.0 publish (npm 7.0.0 + offset 4) break ifc-lite-processing's public API and do NOT ride a pending major. Measured with cargo-semver-checks 0.50.0 against the published 11.0.0, on main at 7aeca8e6d: "semver requires new major version: 5 major and 0 minor checks failed". (1) struct_missing: pdf_vector::PdfVectorDiagnostic removed and (2) struct_pub_field_missing: PreparedPdfVectorPage lost state_qualified, geometry_ready, pending_geometry and diagnostics, both replaced by the page-level FidelityReport (#4547 for #4406); (3) enum_variant_added: PdfVectorOperator, re-exported and not #[non_exhaustive], gained 16 diagnosed-operator variants (Clip, TextClip, Text, Image, Shading, FillPattern, StrokePattern, GraphicsState, GroupBegin/End, FormBegin/End, AnnotationBegin/End, MarkedContent, EndMarkedContent) and (4) enum_no_repr_variant_discriminant_changed: PdfVectorOperator::Unsupported moved 11 -> 27 (#4547); (5) constructible_struct_adds_field on plain request/plan structs: AppearanceRequest.face_masks and AppearanceConversion.{surface_fingerprint, masked_triangles, retained_geometry_item_id} (#4545 for #4404), MeshTransferRequest.max_behind_metres and TransferCoverage.unknown_behind_samples (#4539 for #4381), PdfFillAnnotationRequest.{property_set_global_id, property_relation_global_id, accepted_fidelity_sha256}, PdfFillAnnotationPlan.{property_set_id, fidelity}, PreparedPdfVectorPage.fidelity (#4547). The removals are deliberate supersessions (AGENTS.md anti-cruft: the state-qualified page shape is replaced, not kept beside the report), so the break cannot be made additive; the version-packages PR #4537 carried 11.0.0 -> 11.1.0 and the Rust crate semver gate refused it. Also riding the pending 12.0.0 major, recorded here rather than raising the offset again: ifc-lite-core removed `EntityDecoder::get_polyloop_coords_fast` (inherent_method_missing against the published 11.0.0). The other four published crates are clean on the same tree, each 196 checks, 196 pass, 58 skip, "no semver update required": ifc-lite-core, ifc-lite-clash, ifc-lite-ffi and ifc-lite-wasm. ifc-lite-ffi is measured because scripts/lib/crates-io.mjs publishes SEVEN crates, not six, and a six-crate run would have left one of them unexamined while claiming the set. That control is a signature comparison, so it does not speak for the 58 lints cargo-semver-checks skips per crate behind non-default features, nor for a behavioural break under an unchanged signature. None of StepStats, ProcessingResult or MeshFrame is #[non_exhaustive], and adding the attribute would itself be breaking, so none of them can be made additive; the changesets on all three PRs are `patch`, and a changeset written about the TypeScript API cannot express a Rust break. #4749 changes three further public things, triaged by READING the signatures rather than by the tool.
